documents.title: JUBLCPL: Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Unsecured Creditors To Be Held On September 05, 2026.
Jubilant Agri And Consumer Products Limited Has informed About Hon''ble NCLT Convened Meeting Of Equity Shareholders To Be Held On September 05, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited presented its financial results for Q4 and FY26, reporting revenue from operations of INR 18,911 million for FY26. Adhesives and consumer products sustained high double-digit growth, while tyre cord fabrics and industrial polymers experienced demand softness. Management highlighted upcoming capacity additions, including commencing a new polymer adhesive facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 FY27. Additionally, the Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of its Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited. Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of INR 4,510 million for Q3 FY26, representing a 13% YoY growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects to commence its polymer adhesive manufacturing facility at Samlya, Gujarat, in Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

guidance.claim: Management remains focused on profitable, volume-led growth in Adhesives through new product launches and channel expansion.
guidance.quote: Focus remains on profitable, volume-led growth through new innovative product launches & channel expansion

guidance.claim: The approved NBS subsidy scheme for Rabi 2025-26 is expected to strengthen fertilizer affordability and offtake.
guidance.quote: INR 37,952 crore subsidy approved under the Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) scheme for Rabi 2025–26, with higher support for phosphorus and sulphur nutrients, likely to further strengthen fertilizer affordability and offtake

guidance.claim: The company expects input costs for adhesives to remain stable in Q3 FY26 while continuing strategic spending on advertising and promotion.
guidance.quote: Input Cost to remain stable for Q3 FY26 and continue focus on demand generation thru strategic A&P spends

guidance.claim: The company expects to gain market share following the introduction of a new range of SBR Latex.
guidance.quote: Company expanded its product offering by introduction of new range of SBR Latex, expect to gain market share due to better product offering

demand_outlook.claim: Adhesives revenue growth was supported by strong demand, GST rate reductions, and discretionary spending recovery.
demand_outlook.quote:
The company sustained high double-digit revenue growth, driven by robust demand supported by GST rate reductions and
a recovery in discretionary spending.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand slowed down for replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics in domestic and global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics witnessed a slowdown in demand across both domestic and global markets

demand_outlook.claim: Industrial polymers, food polymers, and industrial chemicals experienced soft demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial polymers, Food polymers and Industrial chemicals faced demand softness

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic construction demand remains stable, supporting growth prospects.
demand_outlook.quote: Stable domestic construction demand, supporting growth prospects

demand_outlook.claim: Adhesives sustained double-digit revenue growth despite a slightly softer demand environment in key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The company sustained double-digit revenue growth despite a slightly softer demand environment in the key markets

demand_outlook.claim: Urban housing demand was uplifted by rising renovations and adoption of modular furniture.
demand_outlook.quote: Urban housing demand uplifted driven by rising renovations and modular furniture adoption

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a slowdown in both domestic and global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics witnessed a slowdown in demand both domestic and global in market

demand_outlook.claim: Industrial and Food polymers experienced demand softness due to uncertainty surrounding USA tariffs.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial and Food polymers faced demand softness due to USA tariff uncertainty but gained share in other regions

demand_outlook.claim: Adhesives sustained double-digit revenue growth despite heavy rainfall across India and a challenging macroeconomic environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite a challenging macroeconomic environment and widespread heavy rainfall across India, the company sustained double-digit revenue growth

demand_outlook.claim: Urban housing growth is being driven by rising renovation activity and increasing adoption of modular furniture.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising renovation activity, increasing adoption of modular furniture driving growth in urban housing

demand_outlook.claim: Slowdown was observed in replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics in both Indian and global markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Replacement tyres and tyre cord fabrics experienced a slowdown in both global and Indian markets

demand_outlook.claim: Subdued demand impacted margins in the industrial polymer and food polymers segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Industrial polymer and Food Polymers margins impacted due to subdued demand

demand_outlook.claim: High double-digit revenue and EBITDA growth was recorded in the chemical business due to better realisations.
demand_outlook.quote: Chemical business recorded high double-digit value growth in Revenue and EBITDA, due better realisations

demand_outlook.claim: Agri Products recorded high double-digit revenue growth in Q2-FY26 due to favorable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment.
demand_outlook.quote: Favourable monsoons and strong agricultural sentiment across key markets contributed to high double-digit revenue growth in Q2-FY26.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established an R&D center at its Samlya plant to develop new SBR latex products.
capex_expansion.quote: World-class R&D center at the Samlya (Gujarat) plant facilitates the development of new range of SBR latex

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its product portfolio into bulk fertilizers with NPK 20:20:0:13.
The Board approved the capacity expansion of Performance Polymers by establishing a manufacturing facility at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved the expansion of its Performance Polymers (WWA and SBR Latex) manufacturing capacity of the Company by setting up a manufacturing facility at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara site.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capacity addition for Performance Polymers is 30,000 MTPA.
The required investment for the expansion project is approximately INR 50 Crores.
The Board approved a capex of ~Rs. 50 crore for expanding the Performance Polymers and Chemical segment at Samlya, Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors of the Company, at their meeting held on Tuesday, November 04, 2025 approved CAPEX of ~ Rs. 50 Crs for expansion of its Performance Polymers and Chemical segment by setting up new manufacturing facilities at its Samlya (Savli), Vadodara Gujarat site.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex will expand manufacturing capacity of the Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

margins_costs.claim: Timely pricing actions and inventory levels helped manage short-term supply disruptions and margins during input cost pressures in March 2026.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost pressures emerged in March 2026; however, timely pricing actions and higher raw material inventory levels enabled the company to effectively manage short-term supply disruption while managing the margins

margins_costs.claim: Higher raw material and packing material costs impacted EBIT margins in Performance Polymers & Chemicals.
margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials and packing materials impacted EBIT margins

margins_costs.claim: The company is mitigating ongoing input cost inflation through strategic sourcing and calibrated price increases.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost inflation persists; mitigating impact through calibrated price increases and strategic sourcing

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur and acid costs rose sharply due to geopolitical disruptions.
Adhesives EBITDA margins received support from lower input costs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins were supported by lower input costs

margins_costs.claim: Higher raw material input costs pressured EBITDA margins in Performance Polymers & Chemicals.
margins_costs.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

margins_costs.claim: An increased mix of value-added products supported better margins and revenue performance in Agri Products.
margins_costs.quote: An increase in value-added product mix supported better margins and revenue performance

margins_costs.claim: Adhesives EBITDA margins remained healthy supported by lower input costs.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins remained healthy supported by Lower input cost

margins_costs.claim: Industrial polymer and Food Polymers margins were impacted by subdued demand.
margins_costs.quote: Industrial polymer and Food Polymers margins impacted due to subdued demand

margins_costs.claim: Chemical business revenue and EBITDA saw high double-digit value growth on account of better realisations.
margins_costs.quote: Chemical business recorded high double-digit value growth in Revenue and EBITDA, due better realisations

orders_capacity.claim: Total capacity for Polymers and Chemicals stands at 80,000 MTPA.
Total capacity for Single Super Phosphate is 400,000 MTPA.
Existing capacity utilization for Performance Polymers is approximately 79%.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital deployment was increased for off-season placement, with liquidation expected by Q1 FY27.
The mode of financing for the proposed capacity expansion is internal accruals.
The Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of the Agri Division into Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on November 04, 2025, approved the Scheme of Arrangement for demerger between Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited (“The Demerged Company”) and Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited (“The Resulting Company”)

capital_allocation.claim: The planned ~Rs. 50 crore capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

risks_headwinds.claim: Regulatory changes in FCO norms for Bio-stimulants lowered Agri Nutrient revenue and margins.
Ongoing geopolitical uncertainty may keep input costs under pressure.
Q3 FY26 net profit included a one-time exceptional charge of Rs. 38.3 million related to four labour codes.
risks_headwinds.quote: PAT – include one-time exceptional items (Rs. 38.3 MN on account of implementation of four labour codes)

risks_headwinds.claim: The business faced headwinds from a challenging macroeconomic environment and widespread heavy rainfall across India.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite a challenging macroeconomic environment and widespread heavy rainfall across India, the company sustained double-digit revenue growth

risks_headwinds.claim: Tariff uncertainty in the USA caused a slowdown in the food polymer business.
risks_headwinds.quote: Food polymer business experienced a slowdown in the USA due to tariff uncertainty however company gained market share in other regions

risks_headwinds.claim: Industrial polymer business faced continued challenges due to a global slowdown.
risks_headwinds.quote: Industrial polymer business continued to face challenges due to global slowdown.

management_commitments.claim: The company will start operating its polymer adhesive manufacturing plant in Samlya, Gujarat in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Company will commence its state of the art Polymer (adhesive) manufacturing facility at Samlya ( Gujarat) in Q1 of FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Increased working capital deployment for off-season placement is expected to be liquidated by Q1 FY27.
Raw material pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Higher input costs for certain raw materials pressured EBITDA margins, but pricing is expected to normalize by Q1 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Input cost is expected to remain stable for Q3 FY26 while demand generation will be driven through strategic advertising and promotion spends.
management_commitments.quote: Input Cost to remain stable for Q3 FY26 and continue focus on demand generation thru strategic A&P spends

management_commitments.claim: The company will set up new manufacturing facilities at Samlya, Vadodara to increase Performance Polymers capacity by 30,000 MT per annum funded mostly through internal accruals.
management_commitments.quote: The capex will be funded mostly through internal accruals and will increase the manufacturing capacity of Performance Polymers business by 30,000 MT per annum.

management_commitments.claim: Shares issued by the Resulting Company under the Agri Division demerger will be listed on BSE and NSE upon completion.
management_commitments.quote: Pursuant the completion of the demerger, the shares issued as consideration by Resulting Company to the shareholders of the Demerged Company shall be listed on BSE and NSE.
